list.name: exp
list.label: Experiment
list.query: SELECT exp FROM metric_sampler.batches GROUP BY exp ORDER BY exp = (SELECT exp FROM metric_sampler.viewer_selection WHERE viewer = '${__user.login}' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) DESC, max(ingested_at) DESC SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run FROM metric_sampler.batches WHERE exp = '${exp}' GROUP BY run ORDER BY run = (SELECT run FROM metric_sampler.viewer_selection WHERE viewer = '${__user.login}' AND exp = '${exp}' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) DESC, max(ingested_at) DESC SETTINGS use_query_cache = 0

list.name: capture_interval
list.label: capture_interval
list.query: SELECT greatest(max(capture_interval), 1) FROM metric_sampler.node_manifests WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}'

list.name: summ
list.label: Summaries
list.query: SELECT if((SELECT count() = 4 AND min(done) + 50 >= (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.step_index WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}') FROM (SELECT summary, max(complete_through) AS done FROM metric_sampler.summary_progress WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND summary IN ('grad_per_rank', 'timing_per_rank', 'loss_position', 'sample_loss_quantiles') GROUP BY summary)), '_fast', '_live') AS summ

list.name: lcsrc
list.label: lcsrc
list.query: SELECT if((SELECT count() = 1 AND min(done) + 50 >= (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.step_index WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}') FROM (SELECT summary, max(complete_through) AS done FROM metric_sampler.summary_progress WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND summary IN ('loss_components') GROUP BY summary)), 'sum', 'live') AS lcsrc

list.name: lssrc
list.label: lssrc
list.query: SELECT if((SELECT count() = 1 AND min(done) + 50 >= (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.step_index WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}') FROM (SELECT summary, max(complete_through) AS done FROM metric_sampler.summary_progress WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND summary IN ('loss_step') GROUP BY summary)), 'sum', 'live') AS lssrc

list.name: stsrc
list.label: stsrc
list.query: SELECT if((SELECT count() = 1 AND min(done) + 50 >= (SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.step_index WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}') FROM (SELECT summary, max(complete_through) AS done FROM metric_sampler.summary_progress WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND summary IN ('step_time') GROUP BY summary)), 'sum', 'live') AS stsrc

list.name: remember
list.label: Remembered selection
list.query: SELECT '' AS remembered SETTINGS log_comment = 'ms-selection ${__user.login} ${exp} ${run}', use_query_cache = 0

panels.title: Loss per step (mean, min and max over ranks and microbatches)

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.* FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, loss_mean, loss_min, loss_max FROM metric_sampler.loss_per_step_${lssrc}(exp_filter = '${exp}', run_filter = '${run}') ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, loss_mean, loss_min, loss_max FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS loss_mean, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS loss_min, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS loss_max FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.description: An empty plot means this measurement has not been recorded for the selection; missing values are not zeros. Missing steps are separated by NULL gap markers; lines do not imply measurements between recorded steps.

panels.title: Gradient norm: global (clipping) and per-rank local before reduction

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.* FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, any(clip_total_norm) AS clip_total_norm, max(total_norm) AS pre_reduce_norm_max, median(total_norm) AS pre_reduce_norm_median FROM metric_sampler.grad_per_rank${summ}(exp_filter = '${exp}', run_filter = '${run}') WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}' AND step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0) GROUP BY step ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, clip_total_norm, pre_reduce_norm_max, pre_reduce_norm_median FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS clip_total_norm, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS pre_reduce_norm_max, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS pre_reduce_norm_median FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.description: An empty plot means this measurement has not been recorded for the selection; missing values are not zeros. Missing steps are separated by NULL gap markers; lines do not imply measurements between recorded steps.

panels.title: Step time, seconds: sampler window (step_s) and the full loop with every callback (loop_s), max and median over ranks

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.* FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, step_time_max, step_time_median, loop_time_max, loop_time_median FROM metric_sampler.step_time_${stsrc}(exp_filter = '${exp}', run_filter = '${run}') ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, step_time_max, step_time_median, loop_time_max, loop_time_median FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS step_time_max, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS step_time_median, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS loop_time_max, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS loop_time_median FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.description: An empty plot means this measurement has not been recorded for the selection; missing values are not zeros. Missing steps are separated by NULL gap markers; lines do not imply measurements between recorded steps.

panels.title: Loss components per step (mean over ranks and microbatches)

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.step AS step, ifNull(nullIf(measured.metric, ''), 'No data') AS metric, measured.value AS value FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, metric, value FROM metric_sampler.loss_components_${lcsrc}(exp_filter = '${exp}', run_filter = '${run}') ORDER BY metric, step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, metric, value FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, metric, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS value FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.description: An empty plot means this measurement has not been recorded for the selection; missing values are not zeros. Missing steps are separated by NULL gap markers; lines do not imply measurements between recorded steps.

panels.title: Разбор шага ${step}: ранг ${detail_rank} и общие значения

targets.rawSql: SELECT mn.name AS metric_name, s.node, s.rank, s.microbatch, s.layer, s.attempt, s.values FROM metric_sampler.scalars AS s FINAL INNER JOIN metric_sampler.latest_attempt_step AS las ON s.exp = las.exp AND s.run = las.run AND s.step = las.step AND s.attempt = las.attempt INNER JOIN metric_sampler.metric_names AS mn ON mn.exp = s.exp AND mn.run = s.run AND mn.attempt = s.attempt AND mn.metric_id = s.metric_id WHERE s.exp = '${exp}' AND s.run = '${run}' AND (s.rank = -1 OR s.rank = toInt16OrNull(${detail_rank:sqlstring})) AND s.step = if(toUInt32OrZero(${step:sqlstring}) = 0, least((SELECT max(step) FROM metric_sampler.latest_attempt_step WHERE exp = '${exp}' AND run = '${run}'), (SELECT step_limit FROM metric_sampler.latest_step_limit(exp_filter = '${exp}', run_filter = '${run}'))), toUInt32OrZero(${step:sqlstring})) ORDER BY metric_name, s.node, s.rank, s.microbatch, s.layer SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.description: Step 0 selects the latest received training step. Rank (step details) selects one card; rank -1 shared or legacy aggregate rows are also shown. All microbatches and layers of the selected card are included. Change the rank to inspect another card; this filter does not change the graphs or stored data.
